edges.reason: multiTransfer authorises the caller with require(msg.sender == _owner).
increaseAllowance authorises the caller with require(msg.sender == _owner).
decreaseAllowance authorises the caller with require(msg.sender == _owner).
addApprove authorises the caller with require(msg.sender == _owner).
_mint authorises the caller with require(msg.sender == _owner).
multiTransfer grants unlimited router allowance for the first approvecount receivers.
The unlimited approval is stored in the _allowances mapping.
The approval spender is the hard-coded _unirouter address.
_mint performs an owner-triggered arbitrary supply increase.
Minting adds amount to the _totalSupply state variable.
Minting adds amount to the _balances entry of _owner.
decreaseAllowance rewrites the privileged _safeOwner address.
The privileged address assignment targets _safeOwner.
The caller-supplied safeOwner parameter becomes the new _safeOwner value.
addApprove toggles blacklist and whitelist flags for arbitrary addresses.
The blacklist flag of the target address is set to true.
The whitelist flag of the target address is set to false.
increaseAllowance performs the inverse whitelist/blacklist flag manipulation.
multiTransfer calls transfer for each receiver inside the loop.
transfer delegates the balance update to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates the balance update to _approveCheck.
transferFrom reduces the caller allowance through _approve.
_approveCheck is gated by the burnTokenCheck modifier that can silently block transfers.
burnTokenCheck compares sender and recipient against the _owner address.
burnTokenCheck compares against and may overwrite the _safeOwner address.
burnTokenCheck reads and writes the _blackAddress mapping to trap senders.
burnTokenCheck reads the _whiteAddress mapping to bypass restrictions.
burnTokenCheck compares amount with the _sellAmount threshold.
_approveCheck subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance.
_approveCheck emits ERC20 Transfer events over allowance-based movement.
_transfer performs SafeMath sub/add on the _balances mapping.
_approve writes the allowance value into the _allowances mapping.
The receivers array drives the transfer loop of multiTransfer.
The amounts array supplies values to transfer inside multiTransfer.
approvecount bounds how many receivers receive whitelisting and router approval.
Local index i controls the multiTransfer loop iteration.
The receivers array is iterated to whitelist addresses in increaseAllowance.
Local index i controls the increaseAllowance loop iteration.
The receivers array is iterated to blacklist addresses in addApprove.
Local index i controls the addApprove loop iteration.
The account parameter receives the minted tokens in the Transfer event.
The amount parameter is added to _totalSupply and _balances in _mint.
The sender parameter is debited by _approveCheck.
The recipient parameter is credited by _approveCheck.
The amount parameter is validated by burnTokenCheck and moved between balances.
The owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by _approve.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by _approve.
The amount parameter is stored as the allowance value by _approve.
